headline: Trailing slashes no longer break the arcade
lede: Links like /retrogames/mario/ — the kind phones, search engines and typo-happy friends produce — used to 404 at the edge while the slash-free version worked. One generic rewrite rule now serves every client route either way, and the harness pins the whole family so it can't rot back.

notes.text: #1402 shipped (PR #1437): a single `/retrogames/:path+/` -> index.html rule before the SPA catch-all fixes trailing-slash routes for every page at once, replacing the per-route patches #1395 started.

Vercel's `:path*` wildcard never matches a trailing empty segment — that single spec quirk caused the whole bug family. rewritecheck's route resolver learned `:name+` semantics and now carries 13 new pins/selftests; deleting the fix turns the check red (proven).
Prod verification must hit www.jalfern.com — the apex domain 308s to www before any of these rules run, so curling apex without -L is how this bug was originally mis-sized.
